hook_line: CANADA HOLDS PR TARGET AT 380,000, OPENS PATH FOR 200,000 ALREADY THERE

hook_stat.sub: Permanent residents Canada will admit a year in 2027, 2028 and 2029

stats.label: Temporary residents already in Canada who can transition to permanent residence by the end of 2027
New temporary resident arrivals capped a year
Of the transition places are skilled workers through Express Entry and the Provincial Nominee Program

diaspora_bullets: The one-time transition is for temporary residents already in Canada
No application route for the 200,000-person transition has been published yet
news_summary: Canada will admit 380,000 permanent residents a year in each of 2027, 2028 and 2029, holding the target flat in the 2027-2029 Immigration Levels Plan released with Budget 2026 on November 5.
payoff: The annual target itself has not risen - the new opening is for people already in Canada.
